title: atadenoise: threshold-variable vs window-variable experiment brief
purpose: Complement the window-size (s=5 vs s=17) comparison already proposed by adding a threshold-variable arm. This isolates whether perceived motion softness comes from the window length or from the threshold values, which are conflated in a single-axis test.
